walkthroughs.body_html:
A subculture is a smaller group within wider society sharing style, music or values.

It gives young people a sense of belonging.

• 1950s — Teddy Boys (rock 'n' roll).
  • 1960s — Mods and Rockers.
  • 1970s — Punks.
  • 1980s — New Romantics, Goths.
  • 2000s — Emos, grime fans.

Subcultures give:

  • An identity.
  • A friendship group.
  • A way to push back against mainstream rules.

Today they often start online. 📱
